findings.summary: The CR/LF check that threw on newline in header values was removed, so values like 'a\r\nInjected: 1' are silently rewritten to 'aInjected: 1' instead of rejected, hiding the bug and breaking callers expecting the throw.

findings.summary: The new sanitizing regex silently strips all characters above 0xFF and control characters except tab, so non-Latin values like '日本語' or 'Привет' are emptied/truncated and 'a\x00b' becomes 'ab' without warning.

judge.reason: Same defect: the regex strips characters above 0xFF at set time, so non-Latin values are emptied.

findings.summary: Every header value is now trimmed of leading/trailing spaces and tabs, whereas the old code only stripped trailing CR/LF, which goes beyond the scope of the change.

judge.reason: Trimming is a different complaint from the Unicode stripping, and it is not a real defect.

findings.summary: NO_PROXY now treats localhost, 127.0.0.1 and ::1 as equivalent, so NO_PROXY=localhost also bypasses the proxy for the other loopback addresses, breaking deliberate proxying (e.g. to a tunnel) and being inconsistent by ignoring the rest of 127.0.0.0/8.

judge.reason: Describes the known loopback-equivalence change in shouldBypassProxy.
